label: RECOMMENDED: revenue and institutions first, knowledge dispersed before the collapse
rationale: Phase A (yr 0-5)  Survive, get a patron, and start the two longest-lead items immediately:
the nitre beds (24 months of biology you cannot buy down) and lens grinding
(your first revenue AND the gift that buys your first patron).
Phase B (yr 5-15) Convert money into PEOPLE. The school is the pivot of the whole game;
every year it is delayed costs more than any single technology.
Phase C (yr 10-25) Write the corpus and PRINT IT. This is the highest expected-value node
in the tree and it is cheap. Everything after 235 AD depends on it.
Phase D (yr 15-40) Iron, acid, precision. The three industrial keys, in that order,
because each one lowers the cost of the next.
Phase E (yr 40-120) Zinc, then electricity. Zinc is the hidden gate; nothing electrical
Phase F (yr 120-250) Vacuum, high purity, semiconductors.
plague_preparedness is forced before 165 AD. It is a defensive node with no technical
payoff and it is one of the highest expected-value items in the file.
corpus_dispersed is forced before 235 AD for the same reason.
gunpowder is deliberately LAST. See 03_SOCIAL_POLITICS.md: it buys favour and it arms
every future usurper during exactly the century when the Empire must not fragment.
